title: Stream transcript (invalid): SESSION_HEARTBEAT with non-empty payload
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with SESSION_INIT followed by a SESSION_HEARTBEAT carrying a 3-byte payload. SESSION_HEARTBEAT payload size must be zero. Must be rejected with SAR_ERR_INVALID_LENGTH.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
SESSION_HEARTBEAT payload must be zero bytes per spec.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
